claims.statement: Customer-side (Sojitz, independent origin) confirms execution — not just agreement: heavy rare earths produced by Lynas are now physically imported into Japan (first ex-China Australia-ore/Malaysia-separated route), under a Dy/Tb supply agreement dating to March 2023, with Sojitz having previously financed Lynas via loan and equity. This externally corroborates the Lynas heavy-REO supply position with a counterparty document (L8-strong direction).

source_doc.title: Sojitz — Begins Import of Heavy Rare Earths from Australia

sources.quote: Sojitz has begun the import of heavy rare earths (HREs) produced by Australia-based Lynas Rare Earths Ltd into Japan.
In March 2023, Sojitz entered into an agreement with Lynas to secure a supply of dysprosium and terbium, two HREs used in the production of neodymium permanent magnets.
Sojitz has previously provided financing to Lynas through loan and equity investment.
This initiative marks the first import of rare earth products made using ore sourced from Australia that is separated and refined in Malaysia.
